lines.en: [You have entered the ‘Final Ark’!]
The moment she landed in the Ark, Jung Heewon found herself facing a host of constellations.
[You have entered the ‘Eight Hot Hells (八熱地獄)’!]
She had no idea what was going on.
“······Of all places, I had to land in hell. Did I do that much wrong in a past life?”
All she knew for certain was that enemies were after her. Watching the potbellied hungry ghosts climb over one another, surging toward her like a mountain, Jung Heewon shouted.
“Uriel!”
Uriel did not answer. But Uriel's protection still dwelt within her. As white wings sprouted from Jung Heewon's back, a red corona enveloped her body.
[‘Hour of Judgement’ activates!]
The moment she swung her sword, the entire horde of hungry ghosts before her was swept away.
[Constellations aligned with evil catch your scent.]
Enemies pouring in without end. They seemed to be beings parasitizing this worldview called the 「Eight Hot Hells」.
Fortunately, she wasn't alone.
“Heewon-ssi!”
Lee Hyunsung came running from somewhere and stood back to back with Jung Heewon.
“You must have done a lot wrong too, Hyunsung-ssi?”
[The Demon King, ‘Ruler of the Red Mist,’ glares at you!]
[The Demon King, ‘Monstrous-Armed Duke,’ expresses hatred toward you!]
[The constellation, ‘Hell Parasite,’ watches you!]
[The constellation, ‘Flames of Muspelheim,’ remains patient.]
If they fought every hungry ghost here, they would run out of magic power.
And the constellations and Demon Kings of hell were also watching for their chance.
“Behind you!”
Hungry ghosts had slipped behind her and lunged, their enormous maws gaping. A shell flew in from somewhere and exploded against them.
“Heewon-unnie!”
It was Lee Jihye's battleship. Brightening, Jung Heewon called out.
“Are the kids with you, too?”
“I think the kids landed nearby with Sangah-unnie and Seolhwa-unnie! And Pildu-ajusshi—”
“We don't have time to worry about that man too!”
Kyaaaaaak!
The beings of hell kept multiplying. Everything from the demon counts they had fought in the [Dark Castle] to beings of demon duke rank they had encountered in the [Demon Realm] began to appear.
All had become part of hell to serve as material for the next scenario.
“An archangel!”
“If we kill them, we can claim the rank of Demon King, too!”

Lee Jihye opened fire on them. As the [Turtle Dragon] spat out every loaded round, hell's crust shifted, spraying lava everywhere. Demons struck by the lumps of lava melted away. But their numbers scarcely diminished.
[This worldview is a domain ruled by ‘Evil.’]
Beings they had thought dead were rising again a few minutes later. Horrified, Lee Jihye shouted.
“General-nim! Where on earth are you! Why aren't the constellations coming!”
But no constellation answered her call.
Not Uriel, not Maritime War God, not Lee Hyunsung of the 999th round.
They had to fight using only their own strength.
Tssssss!
That was when sparks leapt through the air.
[Baaaaat!]
Biyoo appeared through a round portal.
“Biyoo!”
Biyoo's body, once the size of a soccer ball, had grown too large to wrap one's arms around.
「All dokkaebis grow by eating Stories.」
Baaaaat. Curling herself into a tight ball, Biyoo released fierce sparks from her entire body. The sparks soon tore open one wall of the cabin.
Dududududu!
Bullets from automated turrets, flying through the opened wall.
“Is everyone all right!”
Gong Pildu's ‘moving castle’ was there. His [Armed Fortress], grown into a full-scale battle citadel through repeated evolutions of the stigma.
Yoo Sangah, Lee Seolhwa and the two children were on top of it.
“Unnie! Ajusshi! Come up here!”
Taking Lee Seolhwa's hands, Jung Heewon and Lee Hyunsung leapt to the top of the fortress.
Lee Jihye's long sword flashed at the hungry ghosts clambering fearsomely up its walls.
「In a world where no starlight shone upon them, only the companions of <Kim Dokja's Company> saved one another.」
“Let's begin.”
Yoo Sangah controlled the enemies' movements with the power of the [Lotus Pedestal], while Lee Jihye and Gong Pildu kept firing.
Perched at the very front of the fortress, the [Chimera Dragon] unleashed its breath on the constellations approaching through the air.
Jung Heewon's sword strikes rained on the enemies who forced their way through the chaos and climbed up.
Lee Hyunsung's [Steel Transformation] protected their skin, and Lee Seolhwa healed him when he was hurt in their stead.
「One person had conceived all those combinations long ago.」
Among them was a boy who hadn't appeared in the original novel.
“Aaaaaaaaaah!”
[The ‘Wall that Divides Good and Evil’ exercises its power!]
[The constellation, ‘Ruler of the Deepest Pit,’ summons their followers!]
Tsssssss······!
Pitch-black locusts swarmed in and covered hell's sky. They clung to the incarnation bodies of demons recovering from death and began devouring them.
[Aaaaaaaaah!]
Their skin was eaten away each time it regenerated, and the demons screamed in eternal torment.

Hope glimmered in Jung Heewon's eyes as she watched the hungry ghosts' forces gradually dwindle. The battle, once overwhelmingly against them, was slowly turning. Destroying these ‘Eight Hot Hells’ might be impossible, but they could at least buy time.
The problem was the constellations who had yet to intervene.
Tssssss······!
Then the stars occupying hell's sky all began moving somewhere at once. Breaking through the inner walls of the ‘Eight Hot Hells,’ the constellations were all leaving.
As their light vanished, the balance of the entire worldview collapsed. The hungry ghosts could no longer recover and sank into hell's depths.
Only then, barely able to catch their breath, did the companions look at one another.
“······What happened?”
Lee Seolhwa asked, but no one could answer.
All they knew was that something tremendous was happening somewhere, enough to make those stars lose interest in this place.
Everyone's eyes settled on Gong Pildu. With a groan, Gong Pildu began driving the [Armed Fortress].
“All right, I get it. Stop rushing me.”
<Kim Dokja's Company> began following the stars, too. Constellations from all over the ‘Final Ark’ were hurtling toward a single cabin, as though being sucked into a black hole.
「They had never seen so many stars move.」
Neither Jung Heewon, nor Lee Hyunsung, nor Yoo Sangah······ could tear their eyes from the overwhelming spectacle, as though every star in the sky were pouring down. It was beautiful, and thrilling.
「And sad.」
When they suddenly came to their senses, they realized all those stars were swirling around one star.
Through cracks in the broken inner wall, the scene inside the room emerged.
The [Shindanmok] that had broken the sky.
Kim Dokja's stars were fighting around that tree.
[Hold them back! This is our Hwangsanbeol!]
They were the constellations of the Korean Peninsula.
Kim Yushin, who had lost an arm, shouted, and Gyebaek swung his huge ringed saber at the constellations.
Bald General of Justice annihilated enemies with his club, while Seo Ae Il Pil strengthened the constellations' Status with the strokes of his brush in midair.
Transformed into an enormous tiger, First Spiritualist of Joseon faced Mithra's turtle, while Supreme Maegum summoned all her hwarang and held back <Emperor>'s forces.
There was also a constellation they had never seen before. A star with closed eyes at the heart of the tree.
The [Shindanmok]'s Stories surged around that star.
[The constellation, ‘Immortal Wanggeom (仙人王儉),’ gathers the creator gods' probability!]
That star seemed to be one of the Korean Peninsula's ‘creator gods.’
The creator god's protection enfolded Kim Dokja and the Korean constellations, shielding them.
“······General-nim?”
They could also see constellations fighting aboard a turtle ship.
A surging sea brought forth by 「Stage Transformation」. Lee Jihye's sponsor was there.
[This reminds me of that day at Noryang (露梁). It is an honor to fight alongside you, Jungyeong.]
[The honor is mine as well.]
Cheok Jungyeong growled as his sword clashed with Thor's hammer.
But <Asgard>'s army was far too large for the two of them alone to hold back.
[The constellation, ‘Flames of Muspelheim,’ summons their greatsword!]
Before long, the constellations from the same hell as Jung Heewon joined in, too.
No matter how outstanding Cheok Jungyeong and Yi Sunsin were, they couldn't stop them all.
Light flashed from the [Shindanmok], and something began forming at the ends of its branches. Within the shafts of light falling like fruit were people the companions knew well.
“Grandmasters!”
White Pure force aura and Breaking the Sky sword strikes colored the battlefield. With them, Jang Hayoung and the Transcenders of 「Murim」 swept across the field.
Japanese yokai constellations charged to meet them. There were ‘tengu’ holding feather fans, ‘kappa’ rising from the water, and followers of ‘Yamata no Orochi.’
[You are nothing but mere incarnations······!]
Fruit fell ceaselessly from the [Shindanmok].
Amid White Pure lightning coloring the battlefield, beings they had met in the sixth scenario appeared.
“For Kim Dogeza!”
They were the small people of [Peace Land]. Those who had fought the disasters were now descending upon this battlefield to help them.
[The Little Constellation of a Small Planet takes out its ultimate weapon, ‘Dragon Needle.’]
Small people died with every movement of the constellations' swords.
“Ah, aaaaaah······!”
No one could speak at the horrific scene in the cabin.
At the battlefield's center, halfway up a mountain of stars' corpses, the brightest star was also silent.
「Atop the broken ‘Absolute Throne,’ Kim Dokja remained silent.」
Yoo Joonghyuk, Han Sooyoung and Anna Croft were fighting there. Spitting blood and gathering Stories, they were fighting the constellations with every bit of ingenuity they possessed.
「The sky was in upheaval amid the collision of worldviews.」
Odin of <Asgard>, Osiris of <Papyrus>, Shiva of <Vedas>, Nuwa of <Emperor>······. Constellations from nebulae whose names they barely knew joined in, bathing the sky in a flood of light.
「What obscures light is not darkness, but another light.」
In that suffocatingly bright world, the companions felt as though their existence was being denied.
The constellations' starlight was speaking.
Telling them the history they had built was nothing.
[The Giant Story, ‘Demon Realm’s Spring,’ begins its story!]
Jung Heewon knew it, too.
Even if every companion attacked now, they couldn't stop them.
[The Giant Story, ‘Torch That Swallowed the Myth,’ has begun its storytelling!]
They needed a stronger Story. A Story that could bring down all those dazzling stars. The power to destroy every one of those constellations.
But Jung Heewon had no such power. Neither [God Slaying] nor [Hell Flames Ignition] would suffice.
[The constellation, ‘Demon-like Judge of Fire,’ watches her incarnation.]
Jung Heewon looked up at the sky.
Her sponsor, silent until now, was there.
She loved her sponsor dearly. That was why there were things she didn't want to ask of her lightly.
“Kim Dokja······.”
Even so, Jung Heewon spoke.
“······Please save him, Uriel.”
Then her sponsor answered.
[All right.]
Hot flames covered the ground around her. She could feel Uriel standing right behind her. With those noble eyes of hers, she would be seeing the same world Jung Heewon saw.
Suddenly, Jung Heewon was afraid.
「If Uriel were to die here.」
Uriel was a ‘Narrative-grade constellation.’ No matter how strong she was, she couldn't defeat Myth-grade constellations.
Then a delicate hand touched her shoulder.
[Don't worry, Heewon. I'll find a way.]
Uriel's back, as she stepped forward, was smaller than her own. Jung Heewon couldn't take her eyes off it.
[The ‘Most Ancient Good’ begins its story!]
White wings spread from that back, covering the world, and Uriel's True Voice rang out.
[O Eden.]
Jung Heewon felt something shaking inside her.
Something like a fragment was stirring. A heavy fragment that had slept within her ever since the ‘Great War of Saints and Demons.’
[The ‘Wall that Divides Good and Evil’ regains its original power!]
Tssssss!
In the next moment, angels began appearing around them one by one. Ten, a hundred, and soon well over a thousand lesser and intermediate angels.
There were familiar faces among them. Archangel Gabriel. She could even see the spirits of archangels she had thought dead in the ‘Great War of Saints and Demons.’
[Uriel.]
‘Guardian of Youths and Travel,’ Raphael.
That angel, who had always watched the world with sleepy eyes, was slowly kneeling with all the other angels.
[Will you inherit <Eden>?]

Uriel didn't answer. Instead, she looked back at her incarnation. A faint smile touched the proud archangel's face. Jung Heewon shouted. But her voice couldn't reach her. The moment Uriel nodded, Raphael declared.
[Uriel, you are now our Great Good (大善).]
Tssssssss······!
A vast corona enveloped Uriel's entire body.
Resplendent, platinum-colored plate armor.
All of Uriel's Status was manifesting, just as it had on the day she had cut off countless Demon Kings' heads and reigned as the terror of demons.
<Eden>'s strongest star.
The moment ‘Demon-like Judge of Fire’ gripped her sword, every angel rose.
[Angels, let us begin the final ‘Great War of Saints and Demons.’]
Odin to the east, Nuwa to the west, Osiris to the south·····.
Amid the Giant Stories pouring down without respite, we maintained a precarious balance.
[Your incarnation body is collapsing!]

I had already forgotten how many times I'd heard that message. Yoo Joonghyuk, right beside me, was in no better shape. Having taken Odin's and Nuwa's attacks in place of Han Sooyoung and me, his body was already in tatters.
Our eyes met. Yoo Joonghyuk frowned as though to ask what I was looking at, then took something from inside his clothes and swallowed it.
[The incarnation, ‘Yoo Joonghyuk,’ uses a ‘Life and Death Pill’!]
In the end, he had used even the last Life and Death Pill Lee Seolhwa had given him. There were none left now.
[Gaaaaaaah! Hold on!]
The constellations of the Korean Peninsula roared like beasts and swung their weapons.
Kim Yushin, Gyebaek, Gwanchang. All the constellations who had once crossed swords with one another were being reborn as one myth around the [Shindansu].
I could also see Cheok Jungyeong cutting down enemies at the very front.
「[This is why I cannot leave this land, even as I curse it. Only a few of us need to drop dead, yet everyone charges in to die together······.]」
Beside him, Pungbaek raised the wind and let out a thundering roar.
He had opposed us in the Great War of Saints and Demons, but now he was fighting for us.
「[<Hongik> can help you, descendant. No price is necessary.]」
As Pungbaek's wind surged, <Hongik>'s constellations all charged forward on it.
Yi Sunsin's [Ghost Fleet] kept firing, and Gyeon Hwon's arrows pierced stars' hearts.
But the enemies' numbers didn't diminish at all.
[Where is this country called the Korean Peninsula?]
[They're only Historical-grade······! Insects! Wipe them all out!]
Even so, the Korean constellations were holding their ground.
[The Giant Story, ‘Shindansu,’ elevates the power of every constellation of the Korean Peninsula!]
If our enemies had Odin and Osiris, we had a Myth-grade constellation, too.
The Myth-grade constellation amplifying the [Shindansu]'s power, ‘Immortal Wanggeom.’
[The constellation, ‘Immortal Wanggeom,’ says this is all the help they can offer.]
Unlike the other Myth-grade constellations, the presence of ‘Immortal Wanggeom’ was faint. It was probably because of this worldline. <Hongik> had hardly been active in it.
<Hongik>'s constellations had probably been unable to leave the Ark all this time, pushed back by the other Myth-grade constellations.
[Do not turn your backs! We do not retreat!]
[The Story, ‘Backs to the Water,’ begins its story!]
Cheok Jungyeong raised his sword, and Yi Sunsin commanded them.
The heroes of a mythic history that bowed to no myth fought against the gods of distant myths.
Even as their flesh tore and their bodies were slashed all over, they swung their swords without kneeling.
「The Korean Peninsula's territory was shrinking.」

Jeon Woochi, who had been fighting as a white tiger, fell. Seo Ae Il Pil's brush broke, and Yi Sunsin's Ghost Fleet sank ship by ship. Cheok Jungyeong's sword, which had cut down a thousand men and split mountains and seas, was also growing dull.
I had expected this. I had steeled myself for it again and again.
The Story we would write from now on consisted of sentences stained with the blood of stars.
[The <Star Stream>'s final Giant Story is beginning to sprout!]
In the next moment, Thor's axe flew toward Cheok Jungyeong's neck. It was a blow even the Korean Peninsula's greatest warrior couldn't dodge.
[The constellation, ‘Demon-like Judge of Fire,’ releases all her Status!]
Uriel descended onto the battlefield and stopped that blow.
“Kim Dokja! The archangels are here!”
Han Sooyoung shouted.
Archangels descending onto the battlefield amid dazzling flashes. At their center was Uriel, wielding the [Flames of Retribution].
「[······Um, Gabriel and I want to join ‘Kim Dokja's Company,’ too.]」
Uriel had said that to me just before we entered the final scenario.
She wanted to come to our nebula and lend us her strength.
「The constellation who had changed the most from the ‘original’ Kim Dokja knew.」
I didn't really know why Uriel liked our story.
「“Do you want to help us that much?”」
All I could do, cowardly as it was, was take advantage of her goodwill.
[A new ‘Great Good’ has appeared in <Eden>!]
Uriel's Status, surging in splendor.
She was no longer Uriel, the ‘Narrative-grade constellation.’
Rrrrrumble!
[······A new ‘Great Good’?]
The Myth-grade constellations stared at Uriel in shock.
<Eden>'s new Great Good, the being who would replace the Myth-grade constellation ‘Metatron.’
Uriel had chosen to become <Eden>'s leader and help us.
[All seraphim, charge!]
At Raphael's signal, the archangels clashed with the Narrative-grade constellations of <Papyrus> and <Vedas>.
[The ‘Most Ancient Good’ seeks its adversary!]
[Do you believe a ruined nebula can turn the tide?]
Still going strong, Odin pointed his spear at Uriel. The divine spear [Gungnir], said to be inescapable, shot toward her.
[Get lost.]
The [Flames of Retribution] clashed with [Gungnir]'s Status.
Odin's lightning, which tore apart the sky, collided head-on with Uriel's hell flames, which burned hell itself.

A clash of Status against Status. Of the two Myth-grade constellations fighting without giving an inch, it was surprisingly Odin who withdrew first. After he retrieved his spear, his left arm trembled slightly.
[Pathetic, Odin. I'll help.]
Myth-grade constellations were more sensitive to danger than anyone.
The oldest stars in this world, loath to accept any variables. That was why they never took risks.
Exchanging glances in an instant, the Myth-grade constellations all opened fire on Uriel.
Kwakwa-kwa-kwa-kwa!
It was more power than even <Eden>'s Great Good could withstand.
But Uriel did not retreat. Even as feathers were torn from her wings and red Stories splashed onto her white cheeks, she did not draw back her sword.
[You are not my great adversary (大敵).]
Uriel, who had always watched our Stories from the sky. Now her eyes were on me.
[The nebula <Eden> prepares its ‘Giant Story.’]
“Dokja-ssi!”
Jung Heewon and the other companions were running toward us from afar.
Perhaps Jung Heewon knew. What Uriel was trying to do now.
Tssssss!

<Eden> alone couldn't take on all those great nebulae. The abilities of the Myth-grade constellations within this Ark rivaled the whole <Star Stream>. To defeat them, we needed a ‘Giant Story’ with terrifying probability.
[「Stage Transformation」 occurs!]
In other words, an enormous myth that would destroy all those myths.
[I am ‘Demon-like Judge of Fire.’]
Uriel blinked slowly, her eyes burning like a demon's.
[I desire the ‘Evil’ that will give my modifier meaning.]
With those words, flames spreading from the [Flames of Retribution] burned the stars in the heavens. Something was stirring on the other side of hell.
「When the Most Ancient Good called her adversary,」
At that very moment, Lee Gilyoung's eyes rolled white.
「the demon crouched in hell's deepest pit answered the call.」
Something like pitch-black storm clouds was rolling in from beyond the burning sky.
Someone who belonged to neither <Asgard>, nor <Vedas>, nor <Papyrus> was approaching, bearing an evil, sinister aura.
[The constellation, ‘Ruler of the Deepest Pit,’ opens ‘Pandemonium (萬魔殿)’!]
Demons began awakening in hell's burning sky.
[The ‘Most Ancient Evil’ seeks their adversary!]
[The ‘Wall that Divides Good and Evil’ depicts its theme!]
In the Demon Kings' absence, the master of myriad demons, who had lain low for eons, revealed their power.
The two sides of good and evil were colliding, with the Myth-grade constellations caught between them.
「And there was an ancient being watching that clash of good and evil.」
Light began rising from the [Chimera Dragon]'s body as it flapped its wings beside Shin Yoosung.
I had seen this in the original novel, too. At last, Shin Yoosung's dragon was beginning to evolve into an ‘Ancient Dragon.’
A dazzling golden radiance. Having attained the full Status of an ‘Ancient Dragon,’ the [Chimera Dragon] roared toward the sky.
「Dragon Call (Dragon call).」
The howl with which members of the dragon king species call their kin at the cost of their own lives.
Gwaaaaaaaaah!
Dragon roars came from beyond the darkened sky. Traces of electricity and flames flaring everywhere. All the world's dragons were flying in answer to the [Chimera Dragon]'s call.
[The reenactment rate of 「Stage Transformation」 rises sharply!]
Instead of biting into the stars, the dragons began fighting one another to the death.
The [Gold Dragon Heart] that replaced my incarnation body's heart was also pounding.
A sight I had already seen once in the ‘Great War of Saints and Demons.’
「In the heart of the hottest hell, a dragon with seven heads and ten horns will awaken.」
「It is the dragon among dragons. The leader of all dragons born at the heart of Chaos, and the world’s oldest hatred.」
The ‘Dragon Festival,’ a festival of dragons held in the hottest place in hell, had begun.
Belatedly realizing what was happening, the Myth-grade constellations were horrified.
[Th-these bastards couldn't possibly······!]
[Stop them!]
There was no one who didn't know what calamity would come if the ‘Great War of Saints and Demons’ broke out here.
[How dare you! How dare you bastards!]
The few Great Dokkaebis left after Bihyung's sacrifice appeared inside the Ark.
Great Dokkaebi ‘Garang,’ whose horn was broken, was shouting.
[Suppress the Giant Story's probability!]
As the Great Dokkaebis activated their powers, the Ark's Myth-grade constellations all spent their coins.
[The constellation, ‘Master of December 25th,’ does not want the ‘Great War of Saints and Demons’!]
[The constellation, ‘Great Mother God Who Created Man out of Earth,’ does not want the ‘Great War of Saints and Demons’!]
[The constellation, ‘One-Eyed Father,’ does not want the ‘Great War of Saints and Demons’!]
[The constellation, ‘Master of Abydos,’ does not want the ‘Great War of Saints and Demons’!]
As an enormous number of coins was poured in at once, the probability of the unfolding Stage Transformation began to be suppressed.
The <Star Stream>'s probability flowed in the direction the majority wanted. It seemed no one could stop the will of those who possessed the most coins in this world.
「Except for one being.」
The soft sound of an engine behind me. And the familiar smell of cigarette smoke.
“You've come.”
‘Mass Production Maker’ stepped up beside me and spoke.
[My favorite Story.]
He had said something similar when I first met him at the Gourmet Association.
A constellation who loved every Story in this world.
Watching the Story of the ‘Great War of Saints and Demons’ unfold before him, ‘Mass Production Maker’ wore an unreadable expression.
A constellation who had spent his whole life mass-producing SSS-grade items.
[It has taken······ a very long time.]
“I'm sorry.”
[When I first heard my ■■, I was honestly rather puzzled. I never thought that such a ■■ could come to me.]
“Do you think differently now?”

Without a word, ‘Mass Production Maker’ stubbed out his cigarette. He watched the Story of the ‘Great War of Saints and Demons’ with me. All the time we had spent fighting was being reenacted there. ‘Mass Production Maker’ laughed heartily.
[At least I think I understand one thing. Why my Stories urged me to amass so many coins.]
Coins floated from the fingertips of ‘Mass Production Maker.’ More coins than I could even begin to count.
[Was it solely to complete ‘one single stage’?]
The coins accumulated throughout his life were being drawn into the sky. His coins were clashing with the will of countless constellations.
When the furious Myth-grade constellations shouted, ‘Mass Production Maker’ spoke.
The constellation with the greatest authority in this world said,
[Constellations, I am sorry, but I will watch what unfolds on this stage.]
As all his coins were poured into the sky's probability, a probability storm covered the entire Ark. The body of ‘Mass Production Maker’ began to age rapidly.
[The constellation, ‘Mass Production Maker,’ has the ■■ ‘Depletion.’]
[The probability shortfall has been made up!]
[The Giant Story, ‘Season of Light and Darkness,’ is fully reenacted on the stage!]
Tssssssss!
A terrible roar erupted in the heavens. With an explosion, dragons fell to the ground.
Pulling Han Sooyoung and Anna Croft with me, I fled with Yoo Joonghyuk to our companions.
At last, the final chapter of all these scenarios. The destruction of every constellation was approaching.
[Don't get caught up in some ‘Great War of Saints and Demons’! We have overcome apocalypses like this again and again to reach this point!]

The Myth-grade constellations' ‘Giant Stories’ were awakening all at once. As though refusing to be overwhelmed by the scale of the ‘Great War of Saints and Demons,’ every ‘Giant Story’ in the world roared.
But it was already too late.
「The dragon will look once at heaven and once at earth, then bring its tail crashing down. With that single flick, the stars will fall, and one direction (傍位) of the world will vanish.」
Two eyes shining in the darkness.
As the dragon's fierce howl rang out, Han Sooyoung started in alarm.
“Kim Dokja! Don't tell me······!”
“That's right.”
“Are you insane? If you wake that bastard again now—!”
“That's not the one we're trying to awaken.”
I looked at Yoo Sangah, seated cross-legged to one side in deep concentration. Beads of sweat dotted her forehead.
[The ‘Wall that Decides Samsara’ maintains the Apocalypse Dragon's seal.]
As long as she, Sakyamuni's successor, lived, the sealed Apocalypse Dragon couldn't be summoned here.
Bewildered, Han Sooyoung asked again.
“Don't you get it?”
Han Sooyoung stared blankly at the dragons falling from the sky.
The ‘Dragon Festival’ was a ritual to determine the strongest dragon. And the one dragon left at the very end of that ritual became the ‘Final Dragon of the Book of Revelation.’
When had it started? Han Sooyoung's left arm was trembling madly.
[A new ‘Final Dragon of the Book of Revelation’ has been selected!]
Kwoooooooo!
At last, an enormous dragon appeared beyond the Ark's broken ceiling. So vast that it could easily tear apart even most giant stars.
Its final molt was complete, and entrancing black flames burned over its pitch-black, streamlined hide.
[The constellation, ‘Abyssal Black Flame Dragon,’ has manifested in the ‘Final Ark’!]
“He's the Apocalypse Dragon now.”
The Final Dragon of the Book of Revelation.
The great calamity that decided the end of the ‘Great War of Saints and Demons,’ and the <Star Stream>'s most terrible apocalypse.
[The reenactment rate of 「Stage Transformation」 has exceeded its limit!]
The thunder striking through the storm clouds shone with a different light than before.
Odin of <Asgard> and Osiris of <Papyrus> gaped in shock.
“Black Flame Dragon!”
The Apocalypse Dragon's gaze rested briefly on Han Sooyoung's face.
「Perhaps Uriel wasn't the only constellation who differed from the original novel.」
In the original, he had been Delusion Demon Kim Namwoon's sponsor.
The leader of the evil dragons representing ‘Absolute Evil,’ and ruler of the nebula <Black Cloud>.
He raised his head and cried toward the heavens.
At that roar announcing this world's final chapter, the entire <Star Stream> shook.
「[The constellation, ‘Abyssal Black Flame Dragon,’ has the ■■ ‘Unfindable Thing.’]」
I had read what his ■■ was in the original novel.
When he briefly sided with Yoo Joonghyuk in the 1863rd round, there had been a passage about him.
「The evil dragon who suffered the most terrible depression in this <Star Stream>.」
The reason ‘Abyssal Black Flame Dragon’ believed himself to be fifteen was that he couldn't go on living unless he believed it.
An unfathomably long life spanning thousands, tens of thousands of years had made the lonely dragon that way.

To keep from destroying himself, he did not grow old. He did not lose his curiosity about the world. He tormented incarnations or played strange pranks. As his final prank, he betrayed ‘Absolute Evil.’ He sided with Yoo Joonghyuk and died mocking the <Star Stream>.
[The constellation, ‘Abyssal Black Flame Dragon,’ has reached his ■■!]
